endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: mo_usfs_mark_twain_highway_142_narrows_access_20260918 usfs-edw-recreation-opportunities-objectid-6729-recid-21706: Forest Service EDW Recreation Opportunities feature objectid 6729 / recarea 21706 identifies the Mark Twain National Forest Highway 142 River Access, known as The Narrows, and publishes 36.550194,-91.191532. Its description calls this the developed last take-out for the Eleven Point National Scenic River, with a single-lane concrete boat ramp, paved parking, and vault toilet; its activity is non-motorized boating and status is open. MoDOT independently locates the east-side Narrows access and confirms the concrete ramp and paved parking; MDC lists The Narrows (142) among lower-river accesses. The Forest Service point is an access-site anchor, not a surveyed wet toe. A targeted NHD refresh still reports a truncated route-network response for the Cane Bluff reach, so retain review status and document that source limitation.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (mo_usfs_mark_twain_highway_142_narrows_access_20260918 usfs-edw-recreation-opportunities-objectid-6729-recid-21706) on Eleven Point River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
